description: This Java class defines the 'Order' entity for an e-commerce system, including its mappings to a database table, fields for order details, associated order items, and lifecycle methods for persisting and updating timestamps.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Entity representing a customer's order, including identifiers, status, timestamps, and associated order items.

methods.name: getPaymentStatus
methods.description: Returns the payment status of the order.

methods.name: setPaymentStatus
methods.description: Sets the payment status of the order.

methods.name: getTotalAmount
methods.description: Returns the total amount of the order.

methods.name: setTotalAmount
methods.description: Sets the total amount of the order.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the list of order items.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Sets the list of order items.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the order and sets the item's order reference.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to initialize UUID and timestamps before saving.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to update the timestamp before updating.
